# prune

The hourly `web-artifacts.prune` job: runs `pruneWebArtifactCaches`
(`web-artifacts/core`) in a supervised child, main only. No build prunes —
see the parent's CLAUDE.md ("No build prunes") for the two-phase protocol and
why the store lock is held for O(dists + victims) only. Each run logs one line
to `logs/web-artifacts-prune.jsonl` (survey time, lock wait, locked time,
dists re-read, entries removed).

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The hourly web-artifacts.prune job: prunes the shared write-once web caches (artifact store, vendor sets, CSS cache, package assets) off every build's path — dist links read unlocked, only changed dists re-read under the store lock.
- Server:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/jobs/supervised-job.defineSupervisedJob`
    - `primitives/log-channels.defineLogSink`
  - Register: `defineSupervisedJob('web-artifacts.prune')`
